reviewScope: Offline headless screenshot pixels only: page presence, visible text and equation fit, table readability, content separation, lower and rightmost displayed regions. Not mathematical correctness, source fidelity, native render verification, DOM verification, or product acceptance.

scrollInterpretation.reachabilityEvidence: The supplied input declares scrollEndReachable=true for both figures on every surface. This assertion was not rerun.
scrollInterpretation.pixelObservation: Mobile captures show the right-hand curve endpoints and V/V-prime labels of fig-24, and points 2/3 plus the T-axis arrow and label of fig-30. Left-side omissions at the figure viewport boundary are deliberate, not missing-source findings.
scrollInterpretation.limitation: The offscreen left portion was not visually re-opened. No figure-source or figure-semantic conclusion is made. The answer-formula clipping findings concern separate text equations, not the declared 640 px figure windows.

Question 2 prose sits above two separated figures; rightmost V and T axis labels and lower figure edges are present inside the desktop column.
Questions 3 through 6 are fully present below the figures; temperature degree signs, cubic-volume superscripts, scientific-notation exponents and the 500-joule prompt are readable.
No incoherent overlap or clipped question prose is visible; the last question and footer retain clear separation.
All six question-and-answer units are present from the heading through the final explanatory paragraph and bottom return control.
Answer 1 fractions, square-root expression, subscripts and g/mol units are legible without collision with adjacent Chinese prose.
Question 2 figures, rightmost axes and the answer paragraphs below both figures are visible and separated.

The lower Q3 through Q6 equations and SI units are readable. In Q4 the percentage chain includes its final approximately 0.97% term; Q5 shows the approximately 3.14 times 10^4 result; Q6 shows the complete approximately +10.0 K result.
No visible clipping or incoherent overlap affects the desktop answer column or its bottom/rightmost content.
Nonblank page with six numbered choice questions; each A-D option group is visible, including the last D option of question 6.
Question 2 displays both figures followed by four distinct A-D tables. Each table has two readable column headings and five visible body rows, with complete bottom and right borders.
Question 3 density/volume units and subscripted ratio, question 4 squared-speed notation, question 5 scientific-notation options, and question 6 signed temperature-change options are legible.
Option letters, table cells, figures and following question separators do not overlap; lower and rightmost content is present.
Heading, subtitle, all six numbered question units and the bottom return control are present on the full-height mobile capture.
Questions wrap into separated lines; the lower Q3 volume units, Q4 temperatures, Q5 pressure/exponents and Q6 500-joule prompt remain readable.

At the deliberately right-scrolled figure windows, fig-24 shows point 1-prime, V-prime and V; fig-30 shows points 2/3 and the lower-right T arrow/label. The left-side partial marks are the declared scroll boundary.
No unintended clipped prose or incoherent content overlap is visible; the last question and page bottom are present.
Full page is nonblank with all six question-and-answer units, the final explanatory paragraph and the return control. No entire answer unit is absent.
Q1 and Q3 inline equations/units wrap readably; Q2 right-scrolled figure regions and subsequent answer paragraphs are present without incoherent overlap.

Q4 percentage display stops at the second times-100% factor at the text container's right edge; the later numeric fraction and approximately 0.97% terms visible in the desktop answer are not visible on this mobile equation line.
Q5 displayed N calculation has its approximate-result continuation clipped at the right edge, leaving only an initial fragment after the approximation sign.
Q6 displayed temperature-change result reaches approximately +10.0 K, but the K glyph is cut at the text container's right edge.
The Q4-Q6 surrounding prose remains readable and includes separate result statements, but those statements do not resolve the clipped equation/terminal-unit pixels.
The full mobile answer preview was resized by the viewer from 390x6331 to 370x6000; exactly two supplementary 390-pixel-wide crops confirmed the formula-edge observations without resizing.
All six numbered choice questions and all A-D option groups are present; question 6's final D temperature-change option and the lower page margin are visible.
Question 2 right-scrolled figures show their lower/rightmost labels. Its four A-D tables fit the mobile text column, each with two readable headers, five body rows and intact right/bottom borders.
Long Q3-Q6 prompts wrap within the column; fractions expressed inline, squared units, scientific-notation exponents and signed temperature-change option units are readable.
No clipped choice text, table collision or incoherent overlap is visible. Deliberate figure-window left-side omissions are not treated as missing figure content.
